review:
A three-pots game made with Electric Elephant Games, with three very nervous chickens above the reels. Mystery symbols reveal hidden chillies, and each chilli feeds a pot.

Fill a pot and you get its bonus – and up to three can trigger in one spin, combining their features. Five fixed jackpots too. Medium volatility, 5,000x max and 96.22% RTP. You can always see how close each feature is.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
